notes.title: Playtest Now Ongoing | New Officer Makaila Arrives
notes.notes: [p]Commanders,[/p][p][/p][p]A huge thank you to everyone who has jumped into the playtest. Your participation and feedback have been incredibly valuable.[/p][p]After meeting so many of you and hearing your thoughts at events like BitSummit and ChinaJoy, we realized that closing access to the playtest would feel like cutting a great conversation short. So we've decided that:[/p][p][/p][h3]The playtest is now ongoing, with no scheduled end date![/h3][p][/p][p]To support this extended mission, we'll be rolling out regular updates. Today's patch introduces a new officer for Exploration Mode, along with some new narrative content to uncover:[/p][p][/p][p][b]New Officer MAKAILA: [/b]Once destined to be the light of her civilization, a tragic accident caused her to cast it into shadow. She can inspire allies with a warm glow or unleash scorching flame upon her enemies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45643981/3d8bd3c6b0c2bd1b9745bd728c03fcdf6ff7735f.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Story Content:[/b] Discover more of the world through the reworked exploration mission.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45643981/1a933a17bf3352cadafa124eeaeef8e94daf56c2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]General Improvements:[/b] A batch of quality-of-life optimizations and experimental sound effects have been added to improve the overall experience.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45643981/ed7cad784d52fc3538fe1085499fbdd5562ab8c5.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Patch Notes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Content[/h3][list][*][p]New Officer: MAKAILA is now available as a starting officer in Exploration Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]New Narrative: Added new exploration plotlines and branching events with unique dialogues for each Officer.[/p][/*][*][p]Gameplay Change: To ensure tactical integrity, character modification (leveling up, equipping echoes, resetting levels) is now restricted in the combat phase.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX[/h3][list][*][p]Camera: You can now pan the camera by moving your cursor to the edge of the screen. A boundary has been added to prevent the camera from moving too far into unexplored darkness.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Clarity:[/p][list][*][p]Available Duality Swap abilities will now have a glow.[/p][/*][*][p]Abilities on cooldown are now covered with a grey mask.[/p][/*][*][p]Zone object buttons now have a pulse indicator for better visibility.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Status Indicators: Operatives with remaining movement or attack actions are now highlighted on their health plate.[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Flow:[/p][list][*][p]Added a "Skip Confirmation" option for ending your turn, for faster play.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage prediction is now more accurate, accounting for more triggered effects like damage redirection.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Retreat" button is now correctly disabled during the enemy's turn.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]General: Added an option to lock the mouse to the game window (hold ALT to temporarily unlock).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Visuals[/h3][list][*][p]Animations: Officers now play deployment animation when entering the battlefield.[/p][/*][*][p]UI: Iterated the panel for Duality Swap abilities and improved the tooltip layout for tile effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Effects: Updated the outline effect on units and objects to be crisper and more defined.[/p][/*][*][p]Environment: Decorations will now become semi-transparent when a unit is standing on their tile or when hovered over, improving battlefield clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Experimental SFX: Added the first implementation of sound effects for various gameplay actions and UI interactions. This feature can be enabled in the settings menu.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Performance[/h3][list][*][p]Optimized performance to improve average FPS across most scenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the frequency of frame spikes during gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where dialogue could get stuck if the player held CTRL to speed it up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing dialogue text animations to be delayed at incorrect positions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Protection Totem could incorrectly grant damage immunity to units not adjacent to it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where tile trigger effects were not being saved correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash that could occur when exiting to the main menu under certain conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where damage from the "Surround Consume" mechanic was being incorrectly reduced by Defense.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Other[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the credits roll.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated some area and unit names to align with the latest story developments.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]How to join[/h2][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2881620/"][/dynamiclink][/p][olist][*][p]Open the [i]Paraside: Duality Unbound[/i] Steam page  [/p][/*][*][p]Click [b]Request Access[/b]  [/p][/*][*][p]When Steam notifies you, the playtest will appear in your library—download and dive in[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h2]Share your thoughts[/h2][p][/p][p]Your feedback is the compass that guides our development. Please continue to share your thoughts![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Press [b]F2[/b] in-game to report a bug or share a suggestion[/p][/*][*][p]Fill out the survey after completing each mode (it's also available from the main menu)[/p][/*][*][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/fuHadQuAeM"]Discord[/url] to chat directly with the dev team[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]If you're enjoying this journey, please consider adding [i]Paraside: Duality Unbound[/i] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b]. For a small team like ours, that single click makes a huge difference.[/p][p]Thank you for being with us.[/p][p][/p][p]— Paraside Dev Team[/p]

notes.title: Paraside: Duality Unbound Set for Release in 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are happy to announce that Paraside: Duality Unbound is set for release in 2025, on all major platforms including PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series S & X, PlayStation 4 & PlayStation 5, it will debut and be showcased at several events including Bilibili World, Gamescom, PAX West, and Tokyo Game Show.

[previewyoutube=tCpihY6YIeo;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]About the Game[/h2]
Paraside: Duality Unbound, presents rich and detailed graphics together with a powerful and novel challenge. Your experience revolves around mastering Duality Manipulation, a unique mechanic that intertwines directly with your role as the leader of Earth's last stand.

[h3]Setting the Scene[/h3]
In the wake of an apocalypse, lead Earth’s remnants to combat extraplanar threats in a double-sided world of cosmic horror and desperate struggle. Explore unknown territories. Evolve your task force. Manipulate space and minds ingeniously to reignite hope in this new strategic RPG.

In Paraside: Duality Unbound, your experience revolves around mastering Duality Manipulation, a unique mechanic that intertwines directly with your role as the leader of Earth's last stand.

Starting with tactical missions against extraplanar threats, this core mechanic is introduced as you command a team navigating a world torn between two realities. Your decisions in these missions serve as your first foray into leveraging the dual nature of the universe:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937699/8b4b8511364bf6b1030ebd8fe17f274f7a8b7864.gif[/img]

[list]
[*] The world and your battlefield are double-sided
[*] Characters can act simultaneously on both sides
[*] Heed both sides and wield powers to manipulate space & swap positions of friends and foes
[/list]

As you delve deeper into the game, the concept of Duality Manipulation expands, offering innovative ways to alter environment and story.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44937699/9804471421938bae18c5a2f5ed62618446e6ced6.jpg[/img]

[h3]Dangerous, Deep & Difficult[/h3]
The world of Paraside: Duality Unbound is perilous. Eldritch creatures prowl, harsh environments test survival, and cunning foes lay traps that require more than brute force to overcome.

But fear not the darkness, for your mastery of Duality Manipulation turns adversity into advantage. Each obstacle is a carefully designed puzzle. With unique powers at your disposal, the game's difficulty becomes a playground for your ingenuity. Unleash your strength, showcase your wits, and transform insurmountable odds into spectacular triumphs.

[h3]Open-Field Exploration[/h3]
The apocalypse has shrouded Earth in mysteries and dangers, turning familiar landscapes into realms of uncharted exploration. As you navigate this altered world, every corner promises new discoveries. 

Reclaim territories for humanity's remnants, while eluding the threats that emerge from the shadows
Your quest for survival will lead you to new allies, hidden artifacts, and secrets that unlock powerful Duality Arts. Curiosity is your compass in this journey, guiding you through a transformed Earth and the perilous Plane of Shadow.

[h3]Base Management[/h3]
Your HQ is humanity's last beacon of hope, central to carving out a future from the chaos. You are tasked with its evolution: build and upgrade facilities to strengthen your foothold, delve into arcane research to unearth universe secrets, and enhance your Duality Arts to open up new strategic possibilities. Recruitment is crucial; scout the globe for agents with the skills and insights needed to expand your influence.

[h3]Mutating World[/h3]
The world is not a static backdrop, but a canvas for your actions. Each mission regenerates landscapes that adapt to your journey—except for the territories you've skillfully claimed. This ever-changing environment ensures no two adventures are the same, offering fresh challenges and opportunities.

Paraside Duality Unbound is targeted for release in 2025 with more news on this game to be updated through 2024.
